_about: Public-domain Robert Machray, Bishop and then Archbishop of Rupert's Land and Primate of All Canada, for the Word Hoard: his sermons, a pastoral letter, his memorandum on the Church Missionary Society mission, his letters to the Archbishop of Canterbury and the S.P.G., and his remarks on primary education. The novels of his nephew Robert Machray are left out. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 122 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
